main.subtitle: E-Office
main.title: E-Office
main.content: Bring your projects, teams, tasks, and workflows together in one centralized workspace. Plan work, manage sprints, collaborate with your team, and track progress from start to finish.

features.subtitle: Attendance
features.title: Track Attendance with Ease
content: Manage employee attendance with simple and accurate check-in and check-out tracking. Monitor attendance status and daily activity across your organization. Make attendance management easier for both employees and administrators.

features.subtitle: Leave & Holidays
features.title: Manage Leave and Holidays
content: Manage leave types, leave plans, holidays, and weekly offs from one place. Define leave policies and assign suitable plans to employees and teams. Give employees a clear view of their available leaves and time off.

features.subtitle: Clients
features.title: Manage Your Clients
content: Keep all your client information organized in one centralized workspace. Create and maintain client profiles with important business and contact details.

features.subtitle: Organization
features.title: Build Your Organization Hierarchy
content: Create a structured organization tree to represent your workforce clearly. Define role hierarchy and organize employees based on their levels and responsibilities. Maintain employee categories, departments, designations, and reporting relationships. Build a clear structure that makes managing your organization easier.

features.subtitle: Teams
features.title: Build and Manage Your Teams
content: Create teams and bring employees together based on projects and responsibilities. Assign team leads and manage team members from a single workspace. Keep teams aligned and make collaboration easier throughout the project lifecycle.

demo.subtitle: Weblings demo
demo.title: See Weblings Workspace in Action
demo.description: Watch a quick demo showing how Weblings Workspace helps teams stay organized, collaborate effectively, and streamline daily operations.

comparison.title: How much you can save
comparison.titleDescription: Replace expensive software by replacing multiple software tools with one unified workspace. Pay only for what your team needs and scale as your business grows.
